method_note: Simulated evidence-constrained portfolio search based on the Survey handoff; no empirical MCTS or clinical experiment was executed.

selected_primary_idea.title: XenoReadiness: A Mechanism-to-Access Readiness Framework for Translating Genetically Modified Pig Organs into a Safe, Scalable Supplement to Human Donation
selected_primary_idea.research_object: An organ-indication-evidence package for pig-to-human xenotransplantation.
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: Deployable supplementary supply requires simultaneous satisfaction of biological, microbiological, manufacturing, governance, and access conditions; no single strong domain compensates for a critical failure in another.
selected_primary_idea.mechanism: A provenance-aware, non-compensatory gating model prevents biological feasibility from being misreported as system-wide shortage relief.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: Replace ungated translational narratives with domain-specific evidence cards, explicit transfer boundaries, and conditional decision states.
falsifiability: The framework fails its intended claim if biological-only and gated classifications do not differ for any incomplete evidence package.
The framework fails its uncertainty-control claim if removal of model and observation-horizon labels does not change confidence assessments.
The framework fails its supply claim if system bottlenecks are shown not to change predicted deployable supply under sensitivity analysis.
expected_contribution: A common readiness vocabulary spanning biology through access.
A conditional, auditable estimator of deployable supplementary supply.
An abstention rule that distinguishes missing evidence from adverse evidence.
A research-design template that can be adapted across organs without asserting organ equivalence.

competitive_ideas.title: Kidney durability and injury mechanism atlas
competitive_ideas.reason_retained: Useful biological module but insufficient for system-level shortage question.

competitive_ideas.title: Multi-organ capacity and economic scenario model
competitive_ideas.reason_retained: Useful sensitivity module but must be constrained by readiness gates.

high_risk_ideas.title: Longitudinal infection-governance framework
high_risk_ideas.risk: May be too narrow if disconnected from graft and capacity evidence.
high_risk_ideas.value: Makes public-health and follow-up obligations measurable.

rejected_ideas.title: Universal donor-pig optimization recipe
rejected_ideas.reason: Overclaims universality, is operationally sensitive, and violates organ-specific evidence constraints.
